title: Haunted Mine
start: Talk to the zealot at the entrance of the Abandoned Mine in south Morytania.

recommended.t: Balls of wool for extra salve amulets
Methods to teleport to Burgh de Rott
Drakan's medallion (requires The Branches of Darkmeyer) or
Games necklace (requires The Darkness of Hallowvale and 500 Companions levels from Temple Trekking) or
Quick-travel to the Nature Grotto for easier access to the town, if you have reached 100 total levels in Temple Trekking

rewards.t: Crystal-mine key (which can be added to the steel key ring)
The ability to make salve amulets, which gives combat bonuses against undead creatures. Simply use the salve shard obtained at the end of the quest with a ball of wool.
Access to the Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest, where players can create an enhanced version of the salve amulet

steps.t: Speak to the Zealot, north of the mine west of Burgh de Rott. [Chat: 1 I follow the path of Saradomin. › 1 I come seeking challenges and quests. › Accept › 1 Is there any other way into the mines? › 3 Can I borrow your key?]
p: Speaking to the Zealot outside the mine.

steps.t: Pickpocket Zealot to get Zealot's key.
Climb over the cart to the south and crawl-down the cart tunnel.
Run directly west through the cave and crawl-through the cart tunnel.
Re-enter the cave via the southern entrance.
Descend the nearby ladder to the east.
Go down the ladder directly east.
Go down the south ladder (beware of the moving cart — follow it as it moves south and step off the track when you can).
Pick a glowing fungus (J).
Use the glowing fungus on the mine cart (K).
Check points settings (L).

Compare your tracks to the correct version (pictured in bright red). Remember the letters where the track needs to be changed. Pull the levers at (M) and (N) so that the bright red arrows match. (You can also examine the levers to find the corresponding letter).
Return to (L) and check points settings. Click start.
If you fail and manage to put the mine cart in water, you will need to pick another glowing fungus to put into the mine cart.
Your character will say "I wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now?" when the puzzle is complete.
Make your way back to the very first cave room, by backtracking or teleporting out and coming back.

sub.t: You can use the Drakan's medallion or games necklace for quicker access if you have it, to teleport to Burgh de Rott. Otherwise continue with the instructions in this section.
Go up the ladder by the glowing fungus spawn.
Go north past the haunted cart, then the first wing east, climb up the ladder.
Go west, climb up the ladder.
Go west and exit the cave.

steps.t: Go down the ladder east of the cart tunnel from which you just exited.
Go north-east and down the ladder by the doors.
Go west and down the ladder in the north-west corner.
Search the cart just south to get the fungus. [Chat: 1 Take it.]
With the fungus, go back up the ladder.
Run east, go past the ladder going up, and go down the ladder (beware of the moving cart).
Run south (on the east path when it splits) and use Zealot's Key on water valve (P).
Quickly go down the lift directly south of the water valve. Note that if you take too long, you will need to use the key on the valve again.
You should fall into a chamber full of water. From the flooded chamber, walk south onto the track and follow it to the east. Walk down the stairs.
Go directly west and through the door.
Try to pick up the innocent looking key to the west, sitting on the crate just north of the crane.
Kill Treus Dayth.
Pick up the key.

sub.t: Optional: Add it to the steel key ring if you have it.

steps.t: Walk up the stairs you came from (in the east room).
Walk down the stairs to the far west.
Open the large door.
Cut a piece of crystal outcrop.
Quest complete!

sub.t: [Optional] If you want extra salve amulets you can mine multiple crystals.
[Optional] First mine a mithril ore vein to the near the large doors on cave level 2 for an achievement.
You can get there by backtracking. Up the lift, then up the ladder to the north, then up the ladder to the north again. Through both large doors to the West and the vein is immediately north.

p: The long sought-after Salve crystal outcrops

get_inside.text: South-west Morytania
...that leads to a completely flooded cavern.
pic: ...that leads to a completely flooded cavern.

get_inside.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.
Map:Abandoned Mine surface

The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
pic: The shortcut located south-east from the entrance to Tarn's Lair.

get_inside.text: Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.
Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.
To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.
To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).
To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):
#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.
To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):
# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.
To get to the crystal mine (with the crystal-mine key):
# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).
